main_text.l: nem idololatriæ,Creatura divinum honorem tribue re,absque Valentianensi appendice,Sicut Deo. In-fallibile autem est & certò verum, {a} Valentiano judice, quicquid à Nicæna Synodo definitur. Valentianus igitur sophistam agit certò & infallibiliter in idololatriæ Romanæ defensione,cujus moles tali paralogismo nititur.

31 Ita syllogismi nostri propositio contra falsos Socios Iesu persistit vera immotaque: & IDO-LOLATRIAM COMMITTIT sine dubio QVIS-QVIS CREATVRÆ DIVINVM CVLTVM EXHIBET. Consequens est ut singulas assumtionis partes pari firmitudine adversus pares eorun-dem & aliorum Papistarum impetus stare doceam, si vires mihi & otium suppeditarit Deus: cui soli sapienti Servatori nostro sit honor, laus, gloria, & gratiarum actio in omnem æternitatem.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a printer's woodcut, not transcribed. The marginal note's first word is set in a long-s form, read as "Analys." The line-end "ju / dice" has no printed hyphen, so it is written whole as "judice". The "a" reference mark stands before "Valentiano" in the text. The catchword "IOAN-" is read from the lower right corner.
